gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve the details of a specific usage trigger by its SID so that I can monitor its configuration and status.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON object containing the details of the usage trigger, including its SID, friendly name, and current usage metrics.

gold.user: As a user, I need to update the settings of an existing usage trigger to adjust its threshold so that I can better manage my account's usage.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the updated settings and return a confirmation that the trigger has been successfully updated.

gold.user: As an account manager, I want to delete a specific usage trigger that is no longer needed to keep my account organized and avoid unnecessary alerts.
gold.ideal: The API should return a success message confirming that the usage trigger has been deleted.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to create a new usage trigger with specific parameters so that I can be alerted when my usage reaches a certain level.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the trigger parameters and return the SID of the newly created usage trigger.

gold.user: As a user, I want to list all usage triggers associated with my account to review their configurations and statuses.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array containing all usage triggers, including their SIDs, friendly names, and current usage metrics.
